## Rare Candy - Go Backend Developer

🔗 [Apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rarecandy/f87a35a5-172b-429d-a06f-a005d395e420)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Go backend developer building services and GraphQL APIs for Rare Candy’s AI-powered trading-card collector platform. Improving databases, integrations, testing, and marketplace features.
Go backend developer building APIs for Rare Candy’s trading-card marketplace and collector app
- Salary: $160,000 - $180,000 per year
- Tech stack: GraphQL, SQL, Go
- Build and improve backend services in Go for Rare Candy’s collector-facing product
- Develop and maintain GraphQL APIs with mobile and frontend engineers
- Design and evolve relational data models
- Write efficient SQL and safely implement database changes
- Implement business logic, background jobs, and third-party integrations for collections, marketplace activity, and Instapacks
- Write automated tests
- Investigate production bugs
- Improve reliability and performance using logs and metrics
- Around 5–7 years of backend development experience
- Production system or serious side-project experience shipping real features
- Comfortable building in Go, including error handling, interfaces, concurrency basics, and testing
- Experience building or maintaining APIs
- GraphQL experience is a plus, or willingness to learn GraphQL from a REST background
- Experience with relational databases and SQL, including schema design, joins, indexes, and transactions
- Focus on correctness, reliability, and maintainable code
- Comfortable using logs and debugging tools to trace problems through APIs, services, or databases

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Go backend developer building services and GraphQL APIs for Rare Candy’s AI-powered trading-card collector platform. Improving databases, integrations, testing, and marketplace features.
Go backend developer building APIs for Rare Candy’s trading-card marketplace and collector app
Role description:
• Build and improve backend services in Go for Rare Candy’s collector-facing product
• Develop and maintain GraphQL APIs with mobile and frontend engineers
• Design and evolve relational data models
• Write efficient SQL and safely implement database changes
• Implement business logic, background jobs, and third-party integrations for collections, marketplace activity, and Instapacks
• Write automated tests
• Investigate production bugs
• Improve reliability and performance using logs and metrics
• Collaborate with product, design, and engineering to turn ideas into shipped experiences
• Get the backend running locally and understand core services and data models
• Ship backend fixes and features, including well-scoped features implemented, tested, deployed, and verified in production
• Contribute reliably across important parts of the product and take ownership of increasingly important features
Role requirements:
• Around 5–7 years of backend development experience
• Production system or serious side-project experience shipping real features
• Comfortable building in Go, including error handling, interfaces, concurrency basics, and testing
• Experience building or maintaining APIs
• GraphQL experience is a plus, or willingness to learn GraphQL from a REST background
• Experience with relational databases and SQL, including schema design, joins, indexes, and transactions
• Focus on correctness, reliability, and maintainable code
• Comfortable using logs and debugging tools to trace problems through APIs, services, or databases
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup with shifting priorities
• Knowledge of the trading-card or collector world, or fluency in a similar collectible space
• Curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable learning by doing
• Required to submit a resume
• Required to answer application questions about a Go service, debugging experience, and trading-card or collector communities
• Location field is required in the application
Benefits:
• Meaningful equity upside
• Health coverage
• Dental coverage
• Vision coverage
• 401(k)
• Wellness stipend
• Monthly dogfooding budget to spend on cards
• Mentorship and support from experienced engineering leadership
• Equal opportunity and inclusive team environment
Tech stack:
GraphQL, SQL, Go
